phrases: new name on all my documents

questions.help: Lay your documents side by side. If it is the same name written differently (initials, spelling, order), it is a correction.
questions.wording: Are you changing your name to a different one, or fixing how it is spelt or ordered on some documents?

questions.help: Either can work for Aadhaar. The state route differs by state, and so far we have only checked the central route.
questions.wording: Do you want the notice published by the central government or by your state?
